title: Campaigns
metaDescription: Manage your outbound calling campaigns. Create campaigns, import leads, configure dialers, and track performance.

create.title: New Campaign
create.description: Create and configure an outbound calling campaign
create.metaDescription: Create a new outbound calling campaign.
create.detailsDescription: Name and describe your outbound campaign.
create.callerIdHint: Legacy verified caller ID, used only when no phone number is assigned above. Leave as default to use the campaign phone number.

detail.metaDescription: View and manage your outbound calling campaign.

notFound.title: Campaign not found
notFound.description: This campaign may have been deleted or the link is incorrect.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to this campaign
noAccess.description: Only organization admins and assigned members can open this campaign. Ask an admin to add you to it.

completeDialog.title: Complete Campaign?
completeDialog.description: Once this campaign is marked as completed, it cannot be reactivated, edited, or have new leads added. All active agent sessions will end and no further calls will be made. This action is irreversible.

notReady.title: This campaign isn't ready yet
notReady.description: Import at least one lead from the Leads tab before activating. You'll also need a phone number (or caller ID) the campaign can dial from.

toasts.statusError: Could not update the campaign status. Please try again.

fields.name: Name
fields.phoneNumberHint: Calls in this campaign are placed from this purchased number.
fields.callerIdHint: Legacy verified caller ID, used only when no phone number is assigned above.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.description: Create your first campaign to start reaching out at scale.
empty.memberDescription: You have not been added to any campaigns yet.

schedule.title: Calling Schedule
schedule.description: Set when agents can make calls.

leads.title: Leads
leads.inFlightHint: This lead is currently being dialed and cannot be removed.

empty.title: No leads yet
empty.description: Import a CSV file or add a lead manually to get started.

removeDialog.title: Remove this lead?
removeDialog.description: {name} ({phone}) will be removed from this campaign, along with its call attempts and scheduled callbacks. The contact itself is kept and can be added again later. This can't be undone.

toasts.removeError: Could not remove the lead. Please try again.

addLead.title: Add Lead Manually
addLead.description: Type the contact details to add a single lead to this campaign. The contact is created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.
addLead.name: Name *

errors.phoneFormat: Phone must be in international format, e.g. +14155552671.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.duplicate: This contact is already a lead in this campaign.
errors.notAdded: The lead could not be added. Please check the details and try again.
errors.generic: Could not add the lead. Please try again.

csvImport.title: Import Leads from CSV
csvImport.description: Upload a CSV file to add leads to this campaign. New contacts are created automatically and duplicates are skipped.
csvImport.tagsPlaceholder: Assign tags to newly created contacts

dropzone.prompt: Drop your CSV here or click to browse

format.title: Required file format
format.note: The first row must contain the column headers above. Column order does not matter and headers are case-insensitive.

errors.tooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is {size}MB.
errors.importFailed: Failed to import leads. Please check your file and try again.

dispositions.title: Dispositions
dispositions.description: Configure outcome codes agents select after each call.
dispositions.createDescription: Add a new call outcome disposition to this campaign.
dispositions.label: Label

empty.title: No dispositions configured
empty.description: Dispositions are seeded automatically when you activate the campaign, or you can add them manually.

add.title: Add Member
add.description: Assign organization members to this campaign. Only assigned members can participate as agents.

list.title: Campaign Members ({count})
list.description: Users assigned to this campaign who can participate as agents.
list.empty: No members assigned yet. Add members to allow them to participate in this campaign.

removeDialog.title: Remove Member?
removeDialog.description: Remove {name} from this campaign? They will no longer be able to participate as an agent.

settings.lockedHint: Some settings cannot be changed while the campaign is active.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Campaign?
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently delete “{name}” and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.

empty.title: No call activity yet
empty.description: Analytics appear here once agents start dialing this campaign. Charts will populate automatically as calls are completed and dispositioned.

agentPerformance.description: Attempts vs connected calls per agent
